x: It was quite a tonic to see him loping along uphill and down dale to record 28:35 which was a new Club record and a time beaten only by Internationals of such class as Kilby(Coventry) Bullivant (Derby) Craig (Blackpool) Freary (Bolton) and Tulloh (Portsmouth).

Batty, Briault and Johnston lead from Craig, Strong, Turner and Fowler with Don Taylor and Montague partly hidden. Heatley (the winner) and Bullivant complete the leading group. Gerry North, Simpson and Kilby lead the following bunch.

The other competitors, however, were over half a mile ahead and consisted of Kilby (Coventry)Bullivant(Derby) Tim Johnston (Portsmouth) and Price (Bristol) - hardly the four that Bill would have selected to have given such a start over a 6 mile leg.
A mammoth total of 370 runners started, including 48 internationals. Tulloh was 4th, Turner 5th, Fowler 7th, Hyman 9th, Bullivant 12th, J.

He now had the invidious task of chasing Tulloh (Portsmouth) and Bullivant (Derby) who soon showed that they were in great form and we were obliged to watch our runner slowly losing the ground that Gerry North had so valiantly made up on stage VIII.
Could Bill Kerr keep close enough to Kilby and Bullivant to give our last three runners a chance or would these top class runners open up a large gap?
Gerry Williams gained selection for the County team and finished an excellent 58th at Leicester, ahead of such runners as Hyman, Heatley and Bullivant.
Belgrave's strong finish of Major, Gerry North & Kerr looked certain to have the mastery of Derby's Domleo, Bullivant and Taylor. If only Gerry North could be given a lead.
